scripts.build:pages: npm run build-wasm && vite build --mode pages
scripts.build-wasm: cd wasm && npx asc assembly/index.ts --target release && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('public/wasm',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('wasm/build/release.wasm','public/wasm/release.wasm')"
scripts.build-wasm:debug: cd wasm && npx asc assembly/index.ts --target debug
